_doc: Dash -> ability rows per hero (item 32). Values: fires (works during the dash), buffers (held until the dash ends, then goes off if still inside the buffer window), cancels (ends the dash / ability). 'buffer' is the window in seconds after the dash ends. Read by DashRules; docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md mirrors it.

mage.source: Surge is an invulnerable dash; the data lists no lock on the other keys, so E and the spear can be started mid-dash and a tapped bolt waits for the dash to end. Holding the spear is cancelled by a dash (the spear hold ends).
mage.ours: E and RMB are not gated by the dash; a bolt tapped inside the dash goes off at its end.

gunslinger.source: Combat Slide: the rifle keeps firing through the skid (the empowered next shot is the dash payoff).
gunslinger.ours: The ground slide fires the rifle (fires_in_dash); the air roll has no slide, so a tap waits for its end.
